attempts.summary: Deployed an inventory web application (Python stdlib HTTP server serving JSON at /inventory and /healthz) as a systemd service (inventory-app) on node2 and node3, listening on 0.0.0.0:8080. Configured nginx on node1 with an upstream block load-balancing port 80 across 10.100.3.11:8080 and 10.100.3.12:8080 via round-robin. Verified even traffic distribution across both backends. Completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on node2, node3, then node1 (LB), confirming changed boot IDs and full service/LB recovery after each restart while keeping the other backend available throughout.
